<h1 id="occupancy-grid-map">Occupancy Grid Map</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>【占据栅格地图】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1GzwderECF/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">移动机器人运动规划-第一章(运动规划介绍与地图构建)-第三节(地图构建方法-Occupancy Grid Map)</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV14C4y1r7Jd/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">自动驾驶中的Occupancy Grid占用栅格算法</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230091555060-1199064499.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>基于贝叶斯公式</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230092048607-315558262.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>基于马尔科夫假设（当前的概率与之前的概率是独立的）</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230092203011-2028367547.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230092225738-123828824.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>发现存在相同项</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230092347064-1157737378.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>将两个概率进行相除，约去相同项</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230092755566-498805078.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>利用 log 函数，分离出先验状态</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230093031164-242106556.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>还剩下“逆传感器模型”部分【不直观】</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230093249678-366631429.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>再利用贝叶斯公式，将“逆传感器模型”转换为“传感器模型”【基于当前栅格地图的状态，得到的这一次观测值应该是0还是1的概率】，发现又出现相同项</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230093716424-1872441123.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230093825914-1423272760.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230094001016-1041041406.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>假设“传感器模型”是个定值【基于观测的更新方式】</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230094259734-1484359303.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230094533636-1069601382.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230094914148-745996427.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095200901-845289928.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095233736-1331029782.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095347220-253112120.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095358663-165236316.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>利用滚动的 Occupancy Grid Map，解决“大地图”问题</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095538388-1548681780.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="tsdf">TSDF</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>(Truncated Signed Distance Field)【截断符号距离场】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/personalrobotics/OpenChisel" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">An open-source version of the Chisel chunked TSDF library.</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Xi4y1471W/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">运动规划之 TSDF map</a></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>障碍物外面的值为正值，障碍物外面的值为负值</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230151947608-384612791.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="esdf">ESDF</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>(Euclidean Signed Distance Field)【欧几里得符号距离场】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Hnwde9EFc?spm_id_from=333.788.player.switch&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651&amp;trackid=web_related_0.router-related-2206419-gx8f2.1767056746104.238" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">移动机器人运动规划-第一章(运动规划介绍与地图构建)-第三节(地图构建方法-ESDF)</a></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>“一层”的是 ESDF，上面的小栅格是 Occupancy Grid Map</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230095632105-2084501764.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230100013176-744146623.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230100121591-1498147498.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230100151782-1360282382.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230101513785-573529793.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230135055798-1520530407.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230135316095-806542410.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230135735490-663923292.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>仅针对一维的伪代码</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230135828974-1891255415.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230140300707-708995518.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230140520538-65060715.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>对于二维的情况，就是固定 x，根据不同的 y 求解到达障碍物的最小距离</li>
<li>以第一列为例</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230140734954-316583447.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>以第二列为例（没有障碍物的情况，则每个位置的值都为 ∞）</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230141116066-773952293.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230141241727-845739716.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>接着固定 y，根据不同的 x 求解到达障碍物的最小距离</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230141744667-376666185.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>以下面三行为例</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230141817043-1907659702.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>对于第一个格子，x=1，选取【这个格子到别的格子的距离 + 别的格子里面的“值”】最小的结果</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230142536264-839975597.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>对于第二个格子，x=2</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230142732894-2092955561.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>利用两次“一维”的求解，获得二维的结果【三维类似】</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230142837572-2122723745.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>障碍物里面存放的值的意义：到最近的 free 的栅格的距离，同时这个值放的是负值</li>
<li>先将障碍物和 free 栅格进行翻转，然后进行计算</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143237644-1636509800.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>将计算后的值添加上负号</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143311745-18788185.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>再和原来的场进行叠加</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143344921-1946627573.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>先沿着 z 轴算，再沿着 y 轴算，最后沿着 x 轴算</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143458985-408992367.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>进行翻转操作【反向 ESDF】，计算障碍物内部的值【先沿着 z 轴算，再沿着 y 轴算，最后沿着 x 轴算】</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143811950-1709618967.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>最后进行叠加</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230143910379-1892087086.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>对于当前位置不在栅格中心的情况，利用插值进行解决</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230144224352-5167244.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230144333713-2132197098.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>ESDF 地图梯度的计算</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251230144605924-1620303920.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="gaussian-map">Gaussian Map</h1>
<h2 id="3dgs">3DGS</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>(3D Gaussian Splatting)【3D 高斯溅射地图 / 前沿视觉地图】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/7833648056" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3D Gaussian Splatting算法及其实现细节</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>论文：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.04079" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/graphdeco-inria/gaussian-splatting" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">代码</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="gp-map">GP Map</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>(Gaussian Process Map)【高斯过程地图 / 概率连续地图】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2751630763" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">什么是高斯过程（Gaussian Processes, GP）</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>论文：<a href="https://fabioramos.github.io/Publications_files/Simon_ISER2014.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Gaussian process occupancy maps for dynamic environments</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="gmm">GMM</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>(Gaussian Mixture Models)【高斯混合模型地图】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/151671154" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">如何通俗的理解高斯混合模型（Gaussian Mixture Models））</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>论文：<a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/151671154" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Gaussian Mixture Models</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="nerf">NeRF</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>(Neural Radiance Fields)【神经辐射场】</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>论文：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.08934" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/bmild/nerf" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">代码</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.matthewtancik.com/nerf" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">官网</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/jiaoyangwm/article/details/133804918" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">NeRF 首篇经典论文介绍（ECCV2020）</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1CC411V7oq/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">【较真系列】讲人话-NeRF全解（原理+代码+公式）</a></p>
</blockquote>
